company.name: FinBursa
company.shortDescription: FinBursa is an AI-powered private markets platform that connects investors and capital seekers for deal sourcing and investment management.
company.description: FinBursa is an AI-native operating platform for professional participants in private markets, with embedded AI agents across deal management, due diligence, fundraising, and investor engagement. It helps teams run relationships, deals, and fundraising in one place instead of across many disconnected tools. It is particularly well-suited to small and mid-market firms that need institutional-grade infrastructure without the complexity and cost of heavyweight legacy systems.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,300,139 to $30,291,530, a 2.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 87 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
